sentences.zh: 是一种无与伦比的荣幸，这是我从未体验过的，我迫不及待地想与大家分享

sentences.zh: 那是深夜的某个时刻

Earlier that evening, the second biggest earthquake ever measured at the
sentences.zh: 那天傍晚早些时候，发生了当时测得的第二大地震，

sentences.en: time, an insane 9.2 had mangled Anchorage, Alaska.
sentences.zh: 一场疯狂的9.2级大地震摧毁了阿拉斯加州的安克雷奇。

sentences.zh: 115人丧生。

sentences.zh: 房屋直接

sentences.zh: 倒转或是滑入了海中。

sentences.zh: 城里没有灯光也没有电力，而且在

sentences.zh: 很长一段时间里，几乎与外界没有任何通信。

sentences.zh: 但还有广播。

sentences.en: Are we on the air?
sentences.zh: 我们在播出了吗？

sentences.en: Yes?

sentences.zh: 我们准备好重新开始了。

sentences.en: It was a station in Anchorage running on backup generators and a cracked transmitter.
sentences.zh: 这是安克雷奇的一家电台，靠备用发电机和破损的发射机运行。

sentences.en: A station in Fairbanks picked up that signal and repeated it.
sentences.zh: 费尔班克斯的一家电台接收到了这个信号并进行了转播。

sentences.en: And a man in Juneau somehow picked up that Fairbanks station, called a radio station in Seattle, and let the broadcast play over the phone.
sentences.zh: 朱诺的一个人不知怎么接收到了费尔班克斯电台的信号，给西雅图的一家广播电台打了电话，让这段广播通过电话播放出去。

sentences.en: The Boy Scout troop that went overnight to McHugh Creek, Bill Noble would like to get a message if they are all right.
sentences.zh: 去麦克休溪过夜的童子军小队，比尔·诺贝尔希望能传个消息看他们是否安全。

sentences.en: Like that, a voice from Anchorage touched the lower 48, a sign the city was still there.
sentences.zh: 就这样，来自安克雷奇的声音触及了美国本土48州，这是一个这座城市依然存在的信号。

sentences.en: And soon, the degraded signal broadcast in Seattle was relayed and relayed again,
sentences.zh: 不久之后，在西雅图广播的微弱信号被一次又一次地中继，

sentences.en: until eventually, people across America, then around the world, heard the same woman's voice.
sentences.zh: 直到最后，全美甚至全世界的人们，都听到了同一个女人的声音。

sentences.en: We have word here that Mary Sweet is asked to contact her mother
sentences.zh: 我们这里收到消息，请玛丽·斯威特与她的母亲联系

sentences.en: Mother is at home
sentences.zh: 母亲在家

sentences.en: The president of that Anchorage radio station happened to be on a goodwill tour of Japan
sentences.zh: 那家安克雷奇广播电台的台长碰巧在日本进行友好访问

sentences.en: And when he turned on a radio in Tokyo, he couldn't believe it
sentences.zh: 当他在东京打开收音机时，他简直不敢相信

sentences.en: It was the voice of his own newsgirl back home
sentences.zh: 那是他家乡自己的新闻女郎的声音

sentences.en: The woman's name was Jeannie Chance
sentences.zh: 那个女人的名字叫珍妮·钱斯

sentences.en: John Moellum and the Brink players have her story
sentences.zh: 约翰·穆勒姆和布林克剧团将讲述她的故事

sentences.en: In 1964, Anchorage was the fastest-growing city in America.
sentences.zh: 1964年，安克雷奇是美国发展最快的城市。

sentences.en: A generation earlier, it had been a frontier town without a single concrete building.
sentences.zh: 在前一代人眼里，它还是一座没有一栋混凝土建筑的边境小镇。

sentences.en: Now, it had 100,000 people.
sentences.zh: 而现在，它拥有10万人口。

sentences.en: But it was mostly military buildup and oil speculation.
sentences.zh: 但这里大多是军事建设和石油投机。

sentences.en: The city felt like a bubble that could pop.
sentences.zh: 这座城市感觉就像一个一触即破的泡沫。

sentences.en: Alaska had only been a state for five years, and as one man put it,
sentences.zh: 阿拉斯加建州才五年，正如一个人所说，

sentences.en: You had the feeling that everything is temporary.
sentences.zh: 你会有种一切都是临时感觉。

sentences.en: We weren't all going to leave, but, you know, we might.
sentences.zh: 我们并不是全都要离开，但你知道，我们可能会走。

sentences.en: And that insecurity made every new construction feel monumental.
sentences.zh: 这种不安全感让每一处新建筑都显得意义重大。

sentences.en: It was a bit more proof to people that their city was real.
sentences.zh: 这算是向人们证明他们的城市是真实存在的又一证据。

sentences.en: Like the brand new J.C.
sentences.zh: 就像市中心崭新的J.C.

sentences.en: Penney building downtown.
sentences.zh: 彭尼百货大楼。

sentences.en: This was one of the first big chain retailers to build in Alaska.
sentences.zh: 这是第一批在阿拉斯加建造的大型连锁零售商之一。

sentences.en: And it was huge.
sentences.zh: 而且规模宏大。

sentences.en: And nothing said sophisticated civilization rising out of the wilderness
sentences.zh: 没有什么比一座摆满内衣和搅拌机的五层百货大楼

sentences.en: like a five-story department store full of lingerie and blenders.
sentences.zh: 更能说明从荒野中崛起的成熟文明了。

sentences.en: There were the beginnings of genuine culture in Anchorage, too,
sentences.zh: 安克雷奇也开始萌芽真正的文化，

sentences.en: like the city's all-volunteer symphony conducted by a moonlighting bulldozer operator,
sentences.zh: 比如由兼职推土机操作员指挥的全志愿交响乐团，

sentences.en: and the Anchorage Little Theater, a community troupe run by a cosmopolitan guy
sentences.zh: 以及安克雷奇小剧场，这是一个由一位具有大都会风范、

sentences.en: in a turtleneck named Frank Brink.
sentences.zh: 穿着高领衫名叫弗兰克·布林克的男子运营的社区剧团。

sentences.en: Brink found roles for everyone in his plays, housewives, judges, Air Force officers,
sentences.zh: 布林克在他的戏剧中为每个人都找到了角色，家庭主妇、法官、空军军官，

sentences.en: and he worked his actors hard.
sentences.zh: 他对演员要求非常严格。

sentences.en: He'd just staged his own three-hour epic
sentences.zh: 他刚刚排演了他自己的三小时史诗巨作，

sentences.en: of Alaskan history called
sentences.zh: 一部关于阿拉斯加历史的戏剧，名为

sentences.en: Cry of the Wild Ram.
sentences.zh: 《野山羊的呼喊》。

sentences.en: I know it sounds a little bit like
sentences.zh: 我知道这听起来有点像

sentences.en: waiting for Guffman,
sentences.zh: 《等待古夫曼》，

sentences.en: but they were good.
sentences.zh: 但他们演得很好。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, covering all this life in the city
sentences.zh: 与此同时，记录这座城市所有这些生活的

sentences.en: were two daily newspapers
sentences.zh: 有两份日报

sentences.en: and five local radio stations.
sentences.zh: 和五家本地广播电台。

sentences.en: One of them, KENI,
sentences.zh: 其中一家KENI，

sentences.en: prided itself on being
sentences.zh: 以自己是

sentences.en: the biggest radio network
sentences.zh: 联邦最大州里

sentences.en: in the biggest state in the union.
sentences.zh: 最大的广播网络而自豪。

sentences.en: And one of KENI's biggest on-air personalities
sentences.zh: 而KENI最受欢迎的台柱之一

sentences.en: was a woman named Jeannie Chance.
sentences.zh: 是一位名叫珍妮·钱斯的女士。

sentences.en: Jeannie was 37.
sentences.zh: 珍妮37岁。

sentences.en: She'd grown up poor in Bonham, Texas,
sentences.zh: 她在德克萨斯州邦姆的贫困环境中长大，

sentences.en: then come to Alaska with her husband a few years earlier,
sentences.zh: 几年前和丈夫来到阿拉斯加，

sentences.en: looking for opportunity.
sentences.zh: 寻找机会。

sentences.en: They only sort of found it at firSt.
sentences.zh: 起初他们只是勉强找到了。

sentences.en: He sold used cars, and she watched their three kids at home.
sentences.zh: 他卖二手车，而她在家里照顾三个孩子。

sentences.en: But Jeannie loved radio,
sentences.zh: 但珍妮热爱广播，

sentences.en: so she started working construction every morning
sentences.zh: 于是她每天早上开始做建筑零工

sentences.en: in exchange for child care,
sentences.zh: 来换取育儿服务，

sentences.en: then go to work all afternoon at one of the local radio stations.
sentences.zh: 然后整个下午都在当地的一家广播电台工作。

sentences.en: Back then, women were usually made to cover cooking or fashion,
sentences.zh: 当时，女性通常只能负责烹饪或时尚板块，

sentences.en: but at KENI, Jeannie turned herself into a gutsy, roving reporter,
sentences.zh: 但在KENI，珍妮把自己变成了一名勇敢的奔走型记者，

sentences.en: driving all over Alaska with a mobile broadcasting unit in her car.
sentences.zh: 开着装有移动广播设备的汽车跑遍了阿拉斯加。

sentences.en: She flew with smokejumpers, covered Arctic warfare exercises,
sentences.zh: 她和森林消防伞兵一起飞行，报道北极战争演习，

sentences.en: reported from Inuit villages and crabboats.
sentences.zh: 从因纽特人村庄和捕蟹船上进行报道。

sentences.en: Her voice was part of the city.
sentences.zh: 她的声音成为了这座城市的一部分。

sentences.en: People trusted her, respected her in Anchorage,
sentences.zh: 在安克雷奇，人们信任她、尊重她，

sentences.en: and in a way, women journalists weren't always respected in 1964.
sentences.zh: 而在1964年，女记者并不总能受到这种尊重。

sentences.en: Later, a New York paper celebrated her as
sentences.zh: 后来，纽约的一家报纸称赞她是

sentences.en: an Alaskan housewife and mother of three children
sentences.zh: 一位阿拉斯加家庭主妇和三个孩子的母亲，

sentences.en: who does a man-sized job with a radio microphone.
sentences.zh: 用无线话筒干着男人般的活。

sentences.en: Late in the afternoon of March 27th,
sentences.zh: 3月27日下午晚些时候，

sentences.en: Jeannie was driving her 13-year-old son
sentences.zh: 珍妮开车载着她13岁的儿子

sentences.en: to a bookstore downtown.
sentences.zh: 去市中心的一家书店。

sentences.en: It was Good Friday, and lots of people
sentences.zh: 那天是耶稣受难日，许多人

sentences.en: had already gone home from work for the Easter weekend.
sentences.zh: 已经下班回家过复活节周末了。

sentences.en: A banner across 4th Avenue advertised
sentences.zh: 横跨第四大道的巨幅横幅上宣传着

sentences.en: that weekend's opening at Frank Brink's Theater.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克·布林克剧院那个周末的开幕演出。

sentences.en: They were doing the Thornton Wilder play,
sentences.zh: 他们正在排练桑顿·怀尔德的戏剧

sentences.en: our town.
sentences.zh: 《我们的小镇》。

sentences.en: Curtain was going to go up at 8 o'clock, but at 5.36.
sentences.zh: 大幕本应在8点拉开，但在5点36分。

sentences.en: Jeannie's first thought when her car
sentences.zh: 当汽车在红灯前开始颠簸时，

sentences.en: started bucking at the red light was that she must have blown a tire.
sentences.zh: 珍妮的第一反应是自己肯定爆胎了。

sentences.en: But then, through the
sentences.zh: 但随后，透过

sentences.en: windshield, she saw people knocked down in the street.
sentences.zh: 挡风玻璃，她看到人们被撞倒在街上。

sentences.en: She saw a line of parked cars at the gas
sentences.zh: 她看到加油站停着的一排汽车

sentences.en: station slam together, then separate, then slam again.
sentences.zh: 猛烈撞击在一起，然后分开，接着又撞在一起。

sentences.en: She watched them fold in and out and thought,
sentences.zh: 她看着它们向内外折叠，心想，

sentences.en: it's like a grotesque accordion later one man would say it felt like the earth
sentences.zh: 这就像一个奇形怪状的手风琴。后来一个人说，那感觉就像地球

sentences.en: was whipping the city around like a dog shaking an animal he's killed
sentences.zh: 在挥舞着这座城市，就像一只狗在疯狂甩动它咬死的动物一样

sentences.en: buildings listed off their foundations the huge ground waves moved through the
sentences.zh: 建筑物从地基上滑落，巨大的地面波纹穿过

sentences.en: asphalt like the roads were liquid at the JC Penney building a school kid
sentences.zh: 柏油路面，仿佛道路变成了液体。在彭尼大楼里，一个被困在电梯里的

sentences.en: stuck in the elevator watched a book suddenly levitate off the elevator floor
sentences.zh: 学生看着一本书突然从电梯地板上悬浮起来，

sentences.en: and hang weightless in midair in front of him for a split second it was like he
sentences.zh: 在他面前的半空中失重悬挂了一秒钟，那感觉就像他

sentences.en: was in orbit.
sentences.zh: 身处轨道之中。

sentences.en: And that's when he knew the elevator was falling.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，他知道电梯正在下坠。

sentences.en: The quake went on like
sentences.zh: 地震就这样持续了

sentences.en: this for almost five full minutes.
sentences.zh: 将近整整五分钟。

sentences.en: Then, it stopped.
sentences.zh: 然后，它停了。

sentences.en: And the instant it did, Jeannie threw
sentences.zh: 就在停下的那一刻，珍妮挂上了

sentences.en: her car in gear.
sentences.zh: 汽车档位。

sentences.en: She was a reporter, after all, and still not realizing how severe the
sentences.zh: 她毕竟是一名记者，当时还没有意识到情况有多么严重，

sentences.en: situation was, she raced to the police station to get a quick story for the evening broadcaSt.
sentences.zh: 她赶往警察局，为晚间广播搜集一些快讯。

sentences.en: Inside, all the filing cabinets were thrown over, ceiling plaster heaped on the floor.
sentences.zh: 走进里面，所有的文件柜都被掀翻了，天花板的石膏堆满了地板。

sentences.en: Then a second jolt hit
sentences.zh: 接着第二次剧烈震动袭来

sentences.en: And Jeannie's son, who'd gone off, came running around the corner shouting
sentences.zh: 珍妮走开的儿子跑过拐角大喊着

sentences.en: Come quick!
sentences.zh: 快来！

sentences.en: The Pennies has fallen down!
sentences.zh: 彭尼大楼倒塌了！

sentences.en: An enormous concrete panel had shorn away from the JCPenney's exterior and fallen
sentences.zh: 一块巨大的混凝土面板从彭尼百货的外墙上剥落并坠落

sentences.en: Now the entire building was sagging and running over
sentences.zh: 现在整栋建筑都在下陷和倾斜

sentences.en: Jeannie watched a second panel lurch loose and drop with a roar
sentences.zh: 珍妮看着第二块面板摇晃着挣脱并伴随着轰鸣声坠落

sentences.en: The scene was brutal
sentences.zh: 现场惨不忍睹

sentences.en: Jeannie stepped around part of a body in the snow
sentences.zh: 珍妮绕过雪地里残缺的尸体

sentences.en: A person split in two by the falling debris
sentences.zh: 那是被坠落的废墟劈成两半的人

sentences.en: A Chevy station wagon was flattened, but you could hear a woman still alive inside, calling to the crowd, trying to dig her out.
sentences.zh: 一辆雪佛兰旅行车被压扁了，但你能听到里面还有一个女人活着，在向人群呼喊，试图把她挖出来。

sentences.en: Then, Jeannie rounded a corner, saw the whole impossible panorama.
sentences.zh: 接着，珍妮转过街角，看到了整个令人难以置信的景象。

sentences.en: One entire side of 4th Avenue had just dropped.
sentences.zh: 第四大道的整整一侧已经塌陷了。

sentences.en: For two blocks, everything was 12 or 15 feet lower, in a ravine that had opened under half the street.
sentences.zh: 在两个街区的范围内，所有东西都下沉了12到15英尺，落入了一条在半条街道下裂开的沟壑中。

sentences.en: And the crazy part was, buildings were still intact down there.
sentences.zh: 而疯狂的是，下面的建筑物居然还完好无损。

sentences.en: Cars were still perfectly parked next to their meters.
sentences.zh: 汽车依然完美地停在停车收费表旁。

sentences.en: Men looked up from outside a bar a dozen feet underground like stunned miners.
sentences.zh: 地下十几英尺深的一家酒吧外，男人们抬起头，像受惊的矿工一样。

sentences.en: And still hanging there, over the street, like a cruel caption over this surreal wreckage,
sentences.zh: 而它依然悬挂在那里，街道上方，就像这超现实废墟之上一句残酷的标题

sentences.en: was the theater banner that read, Our Town.
sentences.zh: 是写着《我们的小镇》的剧场横幅。

sentences.en: The quake had knocked Jeannie's radio station off the air,
sentences.zh: 地震震断了珍妮的广播电台信号，

sentences.en: but now the static on the transistor radio she was carrying
sentences.zh: 但现在她随身携带的晶体管收音机里的杂音

sentences.en: suddenly gave way to music.
sentences.zh: 突然变成了一阵音乐。

sentences.en: It meant K.E.
sentences.zh: 这意味着 K.E.

sentences.en: and I was back.
sentences.zh: 和我回来了。

sentences.en: An engineer started talking,
sentences.zh: 一个工程师开始说话，

sentences.en: and Jeannie grabbed the radio unit in her car and cut in.
sentences.zh: 珍妮随即抓起她车里的电台对讲设备插话了。

sentences.en: Go ahead, Jeannie.
sentences.zh: 请讲，珍妮。

sentences.en: She was surprised later when people told her she sounded calm.
sentences.zh: 后来人们告诉她听起来很镇定，这让她感到意外。

sentences.en: It has become obvious that the earthquake that struck Anchorage
sentences.zh: 显而易见，不到一小时前

sentences.en: less than an hour ago is a major one.
sentences.zh: 袭击安克雷奇的地震是一场大地震。

sentences.en: We urge each and every one of you to seek shelter,
sentences.zh: 我们敦促在座的每一位都去找个避难所，

sentences.en: check your emergency supplies,
sentences.zh: 检查你们的应急物资，
